headline: TOR @ CHC matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TOR 3.75 at CHC 4.05, with a projected total of 7.80. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHC: TOR moved -0.42 runs while CHC moved +0.33, changing the projected margin by -0.75 runs. NRFI probability rose +6.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Ben Brown has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Pete Crow-Armstrong, Seiya Suzuki, Nathan Lukes, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Myles Straw because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
